reviews.text: Valerie did an EXCELLENT job grooming my shihtzu mix, Ringo! He looks so handsome!

My pup’s birthday was extra sweet thanks to this ammmmaaazing cake! 🎂🐾💕 He loved every bite! 🐶✨ Thank you for making his special day so deliciously adorable! 🥹🎉 Special shout out to the cake design team 🐾! …

I came in today, 08/31/26, thinking that we had an appt at 3:00pm, but I guess my appointment request hadn’t gone through online (the website was giving me a difficult time when paying for the deposit). We drove 30 minutes to get there and realizing that I never got an appointment confirmation was so embarrassing lol. But everyone was so nice about it and they were able to fit my girl Yuki in (:

Yuki is super nervous and is usually more comfortable with a female groomer, but their only opening was with a male groomer, Glenn, at 4:00pm. The manager came out to speak with me and told me that Yuki would be kept in a kennel until her appointment time, but assured me that the kennel is spacious so she won’t feel claustrophobic. She also mentioned that if Yuki is not doing well in the kennel, that they would bring her out to the front to hangout. They did also give me the option to keep Yuki with me until her appointment time, but I felt comfortable leaving her with them.

Yuki had finished with her mini groom (+ corgi silhouette trim) closer to 5:00pm. The total cost was around $70, so about $90 total with tip. Glenn told me that Yuki was nervous, but otherwise did great! And she looks amazing!!! Yuki was also given a mini treat bag and I was told that she’ll be featured on their Instagram story (can’t wait to see it)!

Overall, I am SO HAPPY with the service Yuki and I received here! We will definitely be coming back. And the front desk staff told me that if the website is ever giving me issues, to just call to schedule the appointment as they don’t require the $40 deposit when scheduling over the phone.

Thank you to the manager, the front desk staff, and her groomer Glenn!!!

The woof gang salon did an absolutely amazing job on my dog Navi. The staff is so friendly and welcoming, and Micky especially was very kind, and treated Navi very well. Definitely a place I would recommend to all my friends and family

5 Stars for Erica A. and Woof Gang Bakery & Grooming Alamo Heights

I can’t say enough wonderful things about Erica A. at Woof Gang Bakery & Grooming Alamo Heights. My cherished toy poodles, Huckleberry and Pippin, have been going to Erica A. for years, and I truly trust her with my whole heart.

Erica A. is an exceptional groomer. She does an absolutely beautiful job every time and, just as importantly, she always listens carefully to my requests and understands exactly what I’m looking for. She is patient, gentle, and clearly loves the dogs in her care.

Leaving my two poodles for several hours of grooming can be stressful for me because they mean the world to me. But knowing they are with Erica A. makes all the difference. I know they are safe, well cared for, and genuinely loved while they’re there. That kind of trust is priceless.

And the entire Woof Gang team is wonderful. We are always greeted with such warmth, kindness, and enthusiasm, and it’s clear that everyone there cares deeply about the dogs and their families.

If you’re looking for a groomer who is talented, trustworthy, caring, and truly exceptional, I wholeheartedly recommend Erica A. and the entire Woof Gang Alamo Heights team. Huckleberry and Pippin are very lucky to have her! ❤️🐩🐩

Such a wonderful experience. Everyone was wonderful at Woof Gang Bakery and Grooming. Marinah my Pug looks so happy and cute. I will be back and highly recommend this phenomenal place.

McKenzie is absolutely fantastic.  I have been taking my fur baby, Adeline, to McKenzie for over a year and she is awesome and the only one that has ever groomed her. Adeline loves the attention she receives from her and always leaves looking furrbulous.

Jessie has been grooming Nola for about 5 years now and has always done a good job. Our pup doesn’t really like new people or environments but has always come home feeling relaxed and happy after her groom.
If you’re looking for a sweet and friendly groomer book with Jessie at Woofgang Lincoln Hts.

I called today just to check availability for my girl, Lulu Bear, and they were incredibly accommodating. They got her scheduled right away for her (very overdue) grooming appointment and were so friendly from the start.

The moment we walked in, the staff was courteous, polite, and genuinely sweet with Lulu. They were prompt with the entire grooming process, and when Lulu came out, she looked relaxed, happy, and of course—beautiful.

I paid around $150 with tip, including add‑ons like anal gland expression, teeth cleaning, and perfuming (the base grooming alone would’ve been about $90). Worth every penny.

Overall, I can’t complain—they did a phenomenal job. Thank you so much for taking such good care of my girl.

This was Bohdis first grooming session and we were a bit nervous, however Erica made sure that Bohdi was in good hands and he most definitely was! She also mentioned that he did soo good for it being his first time! We will definitely bring him back here again! :)

Amazing treats; the staff were very attentive and made me feel very welcome.
Great atmosphere, will definitely return and recommend.
Wonderful job with grooming!  Was delighted to get our pup back happy, fluffy and sweet smelling. The ladies are always gentle and kind.

Great first time grooming with “Woof Gang” and am so glad for the pet professionals that gave my Havanese, Beren, a look that is so cute, and super cool for summertime in Texas! Well worth the time and service costs here:) You will not be disappointed with Woof Gang, not to mention the quality eats, treats, and toys that celebrate fur babies:)

I’ve been taking my girl here for quite a while, and the staff absolutely love her. They always take great care of her and do an amazing job. However, that’s not the reason I’m writing this review.

Today, I went to the bank and then immediately stopped by Woof Gang to pick up some treats for my girl. I was in the store for about 10 minutes and came back outside to find that my car had been broken into and my window smashed. The police officer told me it’s a common problem and believes the suspect followed me from the bank.

What really stood out was how helpful the manager was during the entire situation. She went out of her way to visit nearby businesses and ask if they had camera footage that might have captured my vehicle. It was incredibly kind of her to take the time to help when she didn’t have to.

The staff were awesome throughout the whole process, and I’m very grateful for their support. Thank you all for your kindness and willingness to help during a stressful situation.
Golden doodle groomed by Sam (Samantha). Sam did an awesome job! Prompt and right on time! Papi looks fantastic! Ready for the summer heat and lots of swimming.

Took my Miniature Poodle and Yorkie for their first grooming. I have had bad luck finding a good groomer in San Antonio. I have now found one. The dogs were expertly groomed and I was very pleased. I will definitely go back and recommend them highly.
They are always so caring about our pups.

Wolf Gang went above and beyond for Memo’s cake. After all the stress and emotions surrounding his surgery, this cake meant so much to us and they made it absolutely perfect. The detail was incredible, it looked exactly like him, and you could tell how much care they put into it. I honestly didn’t even want to cut it because it was so beautiful 😭 Thank you for making such a special moment even more memorable for our family. We appreciate y’all more than you know 🤍
Everything about this salon/bakery is amazing!! They make the most adorable cakes and take amazing care of our fur babies!! Highly recommend them for your grooming and birthday cake needs!
